# Physician Side Gigs

> > A comprehensive resource hub for physicians seeking compensation data, contract negotiation guidance, and practice management tools to maximize their career value and navigate healthcare business decisions.

Physician Side Gigs provides salary transparency through RVU/wRVU databases, expert contract negotiation resources, and curated vendor directories. The site emphasizes physician empowerment through education on billing, coding, legal considerations, and private practice optimization.

## Key Topics

- RVUs (Relative Value Units)
- wRVUs (work Relative Value Units)
- Physician compensation
- Contract negotiation
- Salary transparency
- CPT codes (Current Procedural Terminology)
- HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System)
- Medical billing and coding
- Noncompete agreements
- Locums pay
- On-call compensation
- Revenue cycle management
- Private practice resources
- Physician burnout
- Contract review

## Compensation & Contract Negotiation

- [Physician Compensation Data and Contract Negotiation Resources](https://www.physiciansidegigs.com/physician-compensation-databases): Salary databases with RVU/wRVU data, locums rates & call compensation
- [Contract Negotiations: What Physicians Need to Know](https://www.physiciansidegigs.com/contracts): Contract negotiation guide with salary data & noncompete agreement FAQs

## Private Practice Management

- [Resources and Perks for Physicians In Private Practice](https://www.physiciansidegigs.com/private-practice-resources): Vendor directory for practice tools: AI scribes, billing, financing & more

## Billing & Coding Education

- [Understanding Billing and Coding for Physicians: A Primer](https://www.physiciansidegigs.com/billing): Guide to medical billing/coding with CPT, HCPCS standards & resources

## Legal & Professional Services

- [Attorney Database for Physicians](https://www.physiciansidegigs.com/attorneys): Curated directory of healthcare attorneys for contract review & legal aid
